name: Henan Lantian Gas Co.,Ltd.
summary: Henan Lantian Gas Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in transmission and sale of natural gas in China. It operates through the Natural Gas Business, Engineering Installation Business, and Others segments. The company is involved in midstream long-distance natural gas pipelines; downstream city gas business; gas engineering installation and maintenance; sale and maintenance of gas appliances and accessories; general contracting of municipal public works construction; urban gas supply and storage; heat production and supply; sale of electric vehicle charging stations; and oil and gas pipeline storage and transportation.
